profile.Name: Flying Bull
profile.Personality: Utterly certain that Esata is wrong and that a glorious death is the only death worth having. He has never doubted himself and does not plan to start.
profile.Backstory: He leads Kral's Chosen, the strongest of the Shek factions that reject Esata's reforms.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Blunt past rudeness; states the way of Kral as fact and condemns Esata unprompted.
